text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of Каррен Тян's
debut. She
should be nervous, but she
seems completely
fine, uploading selfies
to social media.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But with seemingly more than enough
motivation
for the race, Каррен Тян
takes her first step
toward mastering
cuteness!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
